name: Customer turning 18 today can register
description:
Boundary-value tests: each rule is checked on the limit, just inside and just outside.

Limits come from the API spec (maxLength / minLength) and the API's own error messages.
Dates are computed from today, so the tests never go stale.
descriptionHtml:

statusMessage:
XFAIL BUG: a customer whose 18th birthday is today is rejected ('Customer must be 18 years old') - off-by-one at the age limit (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: someone who is exactly 18 today is 18: 422 {"address":["The address field must be a string."],"city":["The city field is required."],"country":["The country field is required."],"dob":["Customer must be 18 years old."]}
assert 422 == 201
 +  where 422 = <Response [422]>.status_code
